kjv: prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number
mine: who set a table for Fortune and fill cups of mixed wine for Destiny
note: Hebrew gad and meni are the names of the deities Fortune (Gad) and Destiny (Meni), worshipped with banquets; the KJV translates the names as "troop" and "number", hiding the idolatry, though it keeps the wordplay of v. 12 "I will number (maniti) you".
